turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hello! Please share your order number and the email you used to place the order. What would you like to discuss about your damage claim?
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your dispute about the damage claim decision to a colleague, who will take over from here. Your reference is H-1.

input.summary: Customer provided patrick.okonkwo@example.com for SC-3072 and disputes the closure of an existing damage claim. They say staff told them the pale patches were part of the drawing. Please review the prior decision and follow up.
